name: zarchive_list_pop_front_payload
description: zArchiveList::PopFrontPayload removes the circular-list head node, maintains the head/count fields, frees the node, and returns the payload.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session. Functional coverage includes single-node, multi-node, empty-list, and zSound request-list pop paths.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja reconstruction for 0x48cb70 validates the empty-list return, single-node head clear, multi-node relink/head advance, count decrement, and FreeNode tail call contract.
The native smokes verify LIFO pop-front ordering after push-front, count/head transitions to empty, null return from empty lists, and zSound active/free request list removal.
